annotation_protocol.event_unit: scene-level interval with at least one visibly bare head; no person identity tracking
annotation_protocol.time_origin: source timeline origin defined per source session
annotation_protocol.gt_event_start: first source instant with at least one unambiguously visible bare head
annotation_protocol.gt_event_end: first source instant with no unambiguously visible bare head; uncertain visibility belongs to a separate source-unassessable interval
annotation_protocol.short_events_policy: retain short GT events and report duration strata; never delete them to satisfy alarm dwell
annotation_protocol.source_gap_policy: split assessable portions at source-unassessable gaps and retain excluded/uncertain originals with reasons
annotation_protocol.coverage_policy: within the declared annotated range, positive events, explicit negative intervals and source-unassessable intervals must be disjoint and exhaustive

matching_protocol.primary_alarm_measure: application logic trigger, not audible sound or browser presentation
matching_protocol.alarm_evidence_requirement: original valid trigger record with source_session_id, frame_id and source-time mapping; use actual emitted event callback timestamp when separately recorded; otherwise name the chosen valid output-trigger timestamp basis explicitly
matching_protocol.match_rule: alarm mapped source time lies within an assessable GT interval [start,end); first valid alarm matches that GT once
matching_protocol.repeated_alarm_rule: later valid alarms inside the same GT interval are duplicate alarms reported separately, not new recalled GT or false alarms
matching_protocol.false_alarm_rule: valid alarm outside all GT events in an explicitly annotated source-assessable negative interval
matching_protocol.unassessable_alarm_rule: alarms in unannotated or source-unassessable intervals are reported separately and excluded from TP/FP; exclusion reasons retained
matching_protocol.missed_event_rule: all assessable GT events without a valid match are FN, including events missed during system detection outages
matching_protocol.primary_false_alarm_hour_denominator: total completely annotated source-assessable positive plus negative interval duration in seconds divided by 3600
matching_protocol.negative_only_false_alarm_hour_denominat: explicit source-assessable negative interval duration in seconds divided by 3600; report as a separately named metric
matching_protocol.system_outage_policy: report system-unavailable time separately; do not remove it from primary source-assessable observation hours or GT recall denominator to improve results
matching_protocol.recall_denominator: all assessable GT events; excluded uncertain events listed separately
matching_protocol.delay_definition: first valid matching alarm mapped source time minus GT event start
matching_protocol.delay_reporting: median,p95,p99 for matched GT only; always report FN and excluded events beside delay
matching_protocol.undefined_metric_policy: null recall when no assessable GT; null hourly rate when its observation duration is zero; null delay when no matched events or no verified source-time mapping

source_session_record_fields.scene_id: real location/camera/session grouping, never invented from random filenames
source_session_record_fields.source_kind: physical-camera-recording or replay; name the actual acquisition
source_session_record_fields.capture_time_utc: actual capture time or null if unknown
source_session_record_fields.captured_after_model_freeze_proven: true only with provenance evidence; otherwise null or false with basis
source_session_record_fields.license_or_authorization: specific source permission and retained evidence
source_session_record_fields.duration_seconds: decoded source duration, not requested replay duration
source_session_record_fields.time_mapping_artifact: mapping to alarm clock and verified error bound
source_session_record_fields.annotated_range_seconds: start and end of fully annotated range
source_session_record_fields.negative_intervals: array of explicit assessable-negative start/end records
source_session_record_fields.source_unassessable_intervals: array of source-missing/occluded/unlabelled intervals with reasons

gt_event_record_fields.start_seconds: finite nonnegative value in source seconds
gt_event_record_fields.end_seconds: finite value greater than start and no later than source duration
gt_event_record_fields.assessability: assessable or excluded-uncertain with retained reason
gt_event_record_fields.reviewer: human independent review or explicit unreviewed status
gt_event_record_fields.evidence_reference: original frame/PTS references independent of predictions

system_unavailable_record_fields.cause: read failure, inference fault, expiry, output failure or another recorded reason
system_unavailable_record_fields.time_mapping_verified: true only if mapping exists; otherwise record raw clock and keep source values null
